announcements.title: Community Nutrition Seminar — September 2026
announcements.content: The Barangay Manguring Health Center is organizing a community nutrition seminar covering IYCF best practices, malnutrition prevention, and complementary feeding. Parents/Guardians from every zone are invited. Health workers are requested to coordinate attendance with their assigned groups.
announcements.statusText: ✓ Relayed to Parents/Guardians by Nurse Ana Reyes

announcements.title: Monthly Weight Monitoring Drive — September
announcements.content: All Health Workers are directed to conduct monthly anthropometric monitoring for enrolled children. Completed weight and height data must be submitted via NutriLearn by September 30, 2026. Parents/Guardians of children flagged as at risk or stunted should be prioritized.

announcements.title: Updated WHO IYCF Guidelines 2026 — Training
announcements.content: The WHO has released updated Infant and Young Child Feeding (IYCF) guidelines. A briefing for all Health Workers will be held before the content is shared with Parents/Guardians through NutriLearn modules. Attendance is mandatory.

modules.title: Understanding Child Malnutrition
modules.summary: Master the critical clinical differences between stunting, wasting, underweight, and micronutrient deficiencies based on updated WHO standards.
modules.recommendedFoods: Malunggay, Nilagang Itlog, Monggo, Kalabasa, Dilaw na Camote
modules.feedingGuide: Pakainin nang madalas gamit ang siksik-sustansyang pagkain. Isama ang berde at dilaw na gulay sa bawat pinggan.

lessons.title: Stunting vs Wasting: Understanding Growth Failure
lessons.content: Stunting reflects chronic malnutrition affecting height-for-age, while wasting reflects acute recent weight loss.

lessons.title: The First 1,000 Days Window
lessons.content: Nutrition from conception to a child's second birthday permanently shapes brain architecture and physical stature.

lessons.title: Critical Micronutrient Deficiencies
lessons.content: Recognizing vitamin A, iron deficiency anemia, and zinc deficiency signs in community health checks.

lessons.title: Growth Chart Interpretation
lessons.content: How to plot and read WHO Z-score growth curves correctly to prevent faltering early.

lessons.title: Catch-up Growth Intervention Protocols
lessons.content: Immediate actionable steps when a child begins crossing downward percentile thresholds.

modules.title: Complementary Feeding for Infants
modules.summary: Step-by-step guidance on introducing solid foods at 6 months while continuing breastfeeding, focusing on consistency and meal frequency.
modules.recommendedFoods: Lugaw na may Manok at Malunggay, Minasang Papaya, Nilagang Dilaw ng Itlog, Mashed Avocado
modules.feedingGuide: Magsimula sa malambot at madulas na lugaw sa edad na 6 buwan. Dagdagan ang lapot at dalas habang lumalaki ang sanggol.

lessons.title: When to Start: The 6-Month Mark
lessons.content: Why introducing foods before 6 months increases infection risk and delays proper gut maturation.

lessons.title: Texture Progression from Puree to Solids
lessons.content: Moving safely from smooth purees to practical mashed family foods without choking hazards.

lessons.title: Meal Frequency & Portions by Age Band
lessons.content: 2-3 meals daily at 6-8 months, transitioning to 3-4 meals plus nutritious snacks at 9-23 months.

lessons.title: Energy Density: Fortifying Lugaw
lessons.content: Transforming plain water lugaw into nutrient-dense porridge with egg yolk, crushed seeds, and greens.

lessons.title: Safe Water & Meal Preparation Hygiene
lessons.content: Handwashing and sanitary food storage techniques to prevent diarrheal disease.

lessons.title: Responsive Cue Recognition
lessons.content: Reading baby's natural cues for hunger and fullness without coercive feeding.

modules.title: Affordable Nutrient-Dense Meals
modules.summary: Cook balanced, budget-friendly Filipino meals using accessible barangay ingredients aligned with FNRI Pinggang Pinoy guidelines.
modules.recommendedFoods: Ginisang Monggo na may Malunggay, Tortang Talong na may Giniling, Sinabawang Isda, Kamote Cue na Walang Asukal
modules.feedingGuide: Sundin ang Pinggang Pinoy: kalahating plato ng gulay at prutas, sang-kapat na protina, at sang-kapat na kanin o pampalakas.

lessons.title: Pinggang Pinoy Food Group Proportions
lessons.content: Mastering Go, Grow, and Glow balance tailored for growing toddlers and nursing mothers.

lessons.title: Malunggay: The Miracle Local Superfood
lessons.content: High calcium, iron, and vitamin A content in fresh backyard moringa leaves.

lessons.title: Monggo & Legumes as Complete Proteins
lessons.content: Combining legumes with rice to deliver high-quality amino acids at minimal household expense.

lessons.title: One Egg a Day: Proven Stunting Prevention
lessons.content: Clinical evidence on how 1 egg daily provides choline, DHA, and bioavailable protein for linear growth.

lessons.title: Nutrient-Dense Local Root Crops
lessons.content: Yellow camote and gabi as vitamin-rich carbohydrate sources superior to refined white flour.

lessons.title: Budget Smart Marketing & Ingredient Sourcing
lessons.content: How to stretch PHP 150-200 to feed a family of four nutrient-dense whole foods.

lessons.title: Cooking Methods that Preserve Vitamins
lessons.content: Steaming and quick simmering techniques that prevent heat-sensitive micronutrient breakdown.

lessons.title: Batch Meal Prep for Busy Caregivers
lessons.content: Time-saving storage and reheating strategies for community health workers and working parents.

modules.title: Responsive Feeding Behaviors
modules.summary: Develop positive mealtime routines, handle picky eating with patience, and avoid screen distractions to nurture lifelong healthy relationships with food.
modules.recommendedFoods: Finger Foods: Steamed Carrot Sticks, Soft Banana Slices, Boiled Egg Wedges, Avocado Cubes
modules.feedingGuide: Huwag pilitin ang bata kung busog na. Kumain nang sabay-sabay bilang pamilya nang walang TV o cellphone sa hapag-kainan.

lessons.title: Responsive Feeding: Talking & Encouragement
lessons.content: Feed slowly and patiently with encouragement, never force-feeding. Maintain eye contact and smile.

lessons.title: Handling Picky Eating with Patience
lessons.content: A child may need to see, touch, and smell a new vegetable 10 to 15 times before accepting it.

lessons.title: Creating a Screen-Free Mealtime Routine
lessons.content: Eating in front of screens disconnects children from internal fullness cues and slows chewing.

lessons.title: Self-Feeding & Fine Motor Skill Development
lessons.content: Offer safe finger foods to build hand-eye coordination and healthy eating confidence.

modules.title: WHO Updated Stunting Guidelines 2026
modules.summary: Comprehensive overview of the latest 2026 World Health Organization standards on community-level child stunting surveillance and intervention.
modules.recommendedFoods: Lipid-based Nutrient Supplements (LNS), Micronutrient Powder (MNP), Iron-fortified complementary foods
modules.feedingGuide: I-monitor ang length-for-age buwan-buwan. Agad na i-refer sa Rural Health Unit ang mga batang may severe linear faltering.

lessons.title: 2026 Revised Anthropometric Screening Criteria
lessons.content: Precision cutoff points for length-for-age Z-scores and community height-board calibration requirements.

lessons.title: Small-Quantity Lipid-Based Supplements (SQ-LNS)
lessons.content: Evidence-backed supplementation protocols for infants aged 6-23 months at high stunting risk.

lessons.title: BHW Community Action & Rapid Referral Pathways
lessons.content: Standardized triage workflows connecting barangay health stations to Municipal Health Offices.
